points: \item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B for AI model training and evaluation, improving answer reliability by ~20% and enabling robust technical auditing of machine learning algorithms.

\item Built a hybrid retrieval workflow combining dense embeddings with BM25 search for data science challenge development, enhancing relevance and technical accuracy in algorithm validation and model evaluation tasks.

\item Developed LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline to assess faithfulness, technical correctness, and statistical validity across hundreds of data science problems, ensuring production-ready solutions with rigorous mathematical derivations.

\item Optimized data processing pipelines through batched query extraction and hyperparameter tuning, reducing computational overhead by ~80% and enabling efficient handling of imbalanced datasets with proper cross-validation strategies.

\item Designed ML-based anomaly detection system with attention to data leakage prevention and overfitting mitigation, reducing false positives by 25% while maintaining model generalization and production reliability.

\item Built end-to-end ML pipeline using ZenML and MLflow, deploying a REST API on AWS Lambda with Docker for automated model training, inference, and MLOps workflow optimization with CI/CD integration.
